# {robux} Developer & Designer Information

Everything you need to know about getting paid at **Echo Customs**.

### How you get paid
> Every order you complete is worth **100 {robux}**.
> Payouts happen every **2 weeks (14 days)**.
> Only orders marked as completed count towards your payout.

### Payout limit
> The maximum you can earn every 2 weeks is **1,000 {robux}**.
> That's **10 completed orders** every 2 weeks.
> Orders completed after you reach the limit won't earn extra Robux in that period.

-# Press the button below to see how many orders you've completed this period.
